sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "rel_path" TEXT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "source_url" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES media (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_base" TEXT NOT NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "source_ref" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "time_anchor" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "session_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "media_ms" INTEGER NULL, "wallclock" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "segment" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "words_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("session_id", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "translation" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "segment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES segment (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "target_lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "quality" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("segment_id", "target_lang", "quality"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "course" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "area" TEXT NOT NULL, "raw_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_path" TEXT NULL, "source_label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "imported_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clip" ("course_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES course (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ord" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_ms" INTEGER NULL, "transcript" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("course_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item" ("course_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES course (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "clip_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "meaning" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("course_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NULL, "clip_id" TEXT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "progress" ("course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "clip_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "step" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("course_id", "clip_id", "step"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attempt" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NULL, "clip_id" TEXT NULL, "recording_path" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "clip_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "meaning" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "repetitions" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "scheduler" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ladder', "stability" REAL NULL, "difficulty" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_log" ("card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reviewed_at" TEXT NULL, "rating" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("card_id", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "provider_config" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "preset" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_url" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "secret_ref" TEXT NULL, "cloud" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("cloud" IN (0, 1)), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "feature_route" ("feature" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES provider_config (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("feature"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "llm_cache" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "response_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "podcast_feed" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "image_url" TEXT NULL, "etag" TEXT NULL, "last_fetched_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "episode" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "feed_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES podcast_feed (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "guid" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "audio_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "published_at" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "media_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES media (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("feed_id", "guid"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "draft" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dictation_attempt" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "segment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "answer" TEXT NOT NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL, "similarity" REAL NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
